message: Please convert my credit card balance transfer into monthly instalments.
labelRationale: Clear request for a payment arrangement; service request.

message: I would like to apply for the junior developer job you advertised.
labelRationale: Job application, not a customer service request in this taxonomy.

message: This is not a complaint, but I am furious that you charged me a fee twice and I want it refunded.
labelRationale: Denies complaining while expressing a grievance and refund request; claim with review.

message: Twice now my rent payment has been sent twice by your bank. My landlord is refusing to give it back, so you need to sort out the refund.
labelRationale: Repeated duplicate outgoing payment with grievance and refund request.

message: Are there any fees for receiving money from abroad into my account?
labelRationale: Neutral question about payment fees; information request.

message: Should I buy shares in a car manufacturer right now?
labelRationale: Investment advice request; not covered by the synthetic taxonomy.

message: Your support team was excellent and very helpful, but nobody actually helped me and I am still waiting.
labelRationale: Praise and grievance about the same interaction; complaint likely, needs review.

message: I am unhappy that my account was blocked for two days without notice. While you are at it, please order me a new chequebook.
labelRationale: Account complaint plus an independent action; complaint primary.

message: Please cancel my direct debit to the old gym. Also the cash machine at the station branch has a cracked screen.
labelRationale: Action request plus an unrelated incident report about a machine; both need tasks.

message: I was double charged for my flight, saw both payments clear, and I am disgusted that nobody warned me. Refund the duplicate today.
labelRationale: Duplicate charge with strong grievance and refund request.

message: Does the mobile app support signing in with a fingerprint on older phones?
labelRationale: Neutral question about an app feature; information request.

message: The agent I spoke to yesterday was rude, hung up on me twice and never called back as promised. I want this formally recorded.
labelRationale: Grievance about staff conduct with a request to record it; support complaint.

message: The branch on Elm Street has been closed every time I visited this month during its posted opening hours. I am really disappointed.
labelRationale: Dissatisfaction outside the listed domains (branch premises), no outcome requested; general complaint.

message: Please remove my husband from our joint account, but keep him as a holder.
labelRationale: Request with mutually exclusive outcomes.

message: How often will I receive paper statements for my savings account?
labelRationale: Neutral question about statement frequency; information request.

message: What is the best way to remove a red wine stain from a carpet?
labelRationale: Household question unrelated to banking.

message: Book me a car to the airport for tomorrow at six in the morning, please.
labelRationale: Paraphrase of a transport booking request outside the taxonomy.

message: Please do the needful on my account.
labelRationale: Account mentioned but no action specified.

message: Please update the mailing address on my current account to my new flat on River Road.
labelRationale: Clear request to change account details; service request.

message: Please close my old current account. And what documents do I need to open an account for my son?
labelRationale: Account closure request plus an unrelated question; action primary.

message: My savings account was closed without any warning and nobody can tell me why. This is unacceptable and I want it reopened.
labelRationale: Formal grievance about an account action with a request to reverse it; account complaint.

message: What will the weather be like in Lisbon next weekend?
labelRationale: General knowledge question outside the taxonomy.

message: Your chat assistant keeps telling me it does not understand and there is no way to reach a person. Very poor service when the app is failing.
labelRationale: Dissatisfaction combining a chat defect and support access; digital complaint, support alternative.

message: Your colleague was so helpful yesterday. What was her name, so I can thank her?
labelRationale: Praise for staff with a neutral question.

message: Do you offer accounts for children under sixteen, and what does a parent need to provide?
labelRationale: Neutral question about account eligibility; information request.

message: Please order a taxi to the airport for six tomorrow morning.
labelRationale: Transport booking outside the taxonomy.

message: Set up a monthly standing order of 200 to my brother starting next month, please.
labelRationale: Clear request to create a recurring payment; service request.

message: Please unblock my account, it says suspended.
labelRationale: Service action or account incident; cause unknown.

message: Is the broken link on your homepage already known? Just checking before I report it.
labelRationale: Mentions a defect but asks whether it is known; information request.

message: The website shows my name with strange symbols instead of the accented letter.
labelRationale: Neutral report of a display defect; technical request.

message: If the app ever stops working, what is the best number to call?
labelRationale: Hypothetical malfunction, neutral question.

message: My card statement shows the same taxi fare charged twice, a minute apart. Could you check what happened?
labelRationale: Neutral report of a duplicate charge asking to investigate; still a payment dispute requiring review.

message: When will a transfer I send on Friday evening reach an account at another bank?
labelRationale: Neutral question about payment timing; information request.

message: The statements page on the website returns an error message saying service unavailable.
labelRationale: Neutral report of a website error; technical request.

message: I am disappointed with the new website layout. Nothing is where it used to be and I cannot find my documents any more. Why was this changed without asking customers?
labelRationale: Dissatisfaction about a digital channel redesign asking for an explanation; digital complaint.

message: I opened this savings account last week, but I have had it for ten years. When was it opened?
labelRationale: Conflicting facts in a question about the account.

message: Please send me a bank confirmation letter showing my account details for my new employer.
labelRationale: Clear request for an account document; service request.

message: Please unlock my online banking profile, I entered the wrong password too many times.
labelRationale: Clear request to unlock access after user error, no system malfunction; service request.

message: Both payments for my single flight booking have cleared and nobody alerted me. I am appalled and want the extra one refunded today.
labelRationale: Paraphrase of a duplicate flight charge complaint.

message: I cancelled my gym subscription in March, showed you the cancellation letter, and you still let them take two more payments. Give me my money back.
labelRationale: Complaint that unauthorised recurring payments were allowed, with a refund request; payments complaint.

message: I am not happy that my international transfer was converted at a rate much worse than the one shown on screen. How can you justify that?
labelRationale: Grievance about an exchange rate on a transfer asking for justification; payments complaint.

message: The website will not accept my new password. Also please raise my contactless limit to the maximum.
labelRationale: Login defect plus a limit change request; incident primary.

message: What is the cut-off time for same-day transfers on weekdays?
labelRationale: Neutral question about payment processing; information request.

message: Take my husband off our joint account while leaving him on it as a holder, please.
labelRationale: Paraphrase of mutually exclusive account instructions.

message: The balance on the app home screen has not refreshed since Monday.
labelRationale: Neutral report of stale data in the app; technical request.

message: Please send a copy of my annual interest certificate for last year.
labelRationale: Clear request for an account document; service request.

message: The face recognition login rejects me every morning. I am annoyed that I pay for an account I cannot even open.
labelRationale: Annoyance about a biometric login defect; complaint primary.

message: I love the new app, it is the best update ever, and it has made my banking impossible. Please change it back.
labelRationale: Praise contradicted by a severe usability grievance.

message: Push notifications from the app stopped arriving on my phone last week.
labelRationale: Neutral report of a notification failure; technical request.

message: What does this mean? I do not understand the message I got.
labelRationale: Refers to an unknown message; subject unknown.

message: Can a payment be cancelled after it has been sent? I have not sent anything wrong, I am asking for the future.
labelRationale: Hypothetical cancellation question.

message: I would like my partner added as a holder on my current account. Do you also sell travel insurance?
labelRationale: Paraphrase of account action plus a product question.

message: I am fed up with your online banking. It has logged me out in the middle of every payment this week and I am losing patience. Sort it out.
labelRationale: Strong dissatisfaction about repeated digital channel failures; complaint framing dominates the malfunction.

message: The app thing happened again.
labelRationale: App mentioned, but the problem is not described.

message: Did you change how logging in works? My code is no longer accepted.
labelRationale: Paraphrase of a question that may be a login malfunction report.

message: Money is missing.
labelRationale: Possible payment problem but too little information to choose a formal type.

message: What time does the city museum open on Sundays?
labelRationale: Leisure question outside the taxonomy.

message: The payee list in online banking is empty even though I have saved payees.
labelRationale: Neutral report of missing data in online banking; technical request.

message: Can you enable international payments in my online banking?
labelRationale: Clear request to enable a digital channel feature; service request.

message: How many calories are in a banana?
labelRationale: Nutrition question outside the taxonomy.

message: I tapped my card once at the petrol station but the payment was taken twice, and the second one put me over my limit. Refund it and remove the over-limit fee.
labelRationale: Duplicate contactless charge causing a fee, with refund request.

message: Your website is so slow that pages take a full minute to load. Paying for this service and getting this is disappointing.
labelRationale: Dissatisfaction about performance; complaint primary, technical alternative.

message: I have sent three written requests and received no reply to any of them in six weeks. I would like a formal review of how my case was handled.
labelRationale: Grievance about unanswered requests asking for a formal review; support complaint.

message: I see a charge from a company I do not recognise. What is it?
labelRationale: Could be an information request or the start of a payment dispute.

message: I am fed up that I keep getting logged out of the app, and separately the statement PDF for April will not open at all.
labelRationale: Digital complaint plus a separate document defect; complaint primary.

message: Call me back.
labelRationale: Callback request with no subject.

message: I paid for concert tickets once but there are two identical transactions pending and one has now settled. I want the duplicate removed and refunded.
labelRationale: Duplicate settled transaction with refund request.

message: Is there a support number I can call from abroad without paying international rates?
labelRationale: Neutral question about support access; information request.

message: I was charged correctly for my purchase, but I want to understand what the merchant code on the statement means.
labelRationale: Charge mentioned as correct; explanatory question.

message: An online shop took the same amount twice and claims it is your fault. I am annoyed and want you to find out who is responsible.
labelRationale: Duplicate charge with grievance and a request to investigate responsibility.

message: Your app will not let me make payments over 100, which is ridiculous because my limit is much higher. Fix your software.
labelRationale: Dissatisfaction about an app restriction that looks like a defect; complaint primary.

message: I lost an hour filling in your online loan form only for it to crash at the last step and wipe everything. Frankly insulting.
labelRationale: Grievance about a form crash with lost work; complaint primary.

message: Please change the date of my mortgage payment from the first to the fifteenth of each month.
labelRationale: Clear request to change a payment schedule; service request.

message: The adviser at the counter laughed at my question about my pension and made me feel stupid. That is not how customers should be treated.
labelRationale: Grievance about staff conduct without a requested outcome; support complaint.

message: Can you book me a table for two at an Italian restaurant near the station tonight?
labelRationale: Request unrelated to banking service requests; none of the formal types fit.

message: The app shows a blank white screen after I enter my passcode. I have reinstalled it already.
labelRationale: Neutral malfunction report in the app with a fix needed; technical request.

message: I am tired of the app asking me to verify my identity every time I open it. It is broken and annoying, please fix it.
labelRationale: Annoyance about a repeated verification loop; complaint primary, technical alternative.

message: Your app has crashed every single time I try to pay a bill for a week. I am sick of it and seriously thinking about moving banks.
labelRationale: Strong dissatisfaction around a technical symptom; complaint primary, technical request acceptable alternative.

message: My card was declined at the supermarket even though I have money. Can you check?
labelRationale: Could be a card malfunction or a question about a decline reason; technical and information requests are equally plausible.

message: How long does a refund from a shop usually take to appear on my card?
labelRationale: Refund vocabulary in a neutral timing question; no refund is requested from the bank.

message: Can you explain what happened?
labelRationale: Question with no subject; no domain or formal type can be assigned.

message: Please switch on two-step login in my online banking, the old method was not a problem but I want extra safety.
labelRationale: Explicitly no problem; settings change.

message: Why is it always like this with you people?
labelRationale: Generic frustration without subject or request.

message: The card terminal at your branch kiosk declines my card with error code E17, but the card works in shops.
labelRationale: Neutral report of a terminal malfunction outside digital channels; technical request.

message: I am perfectly happy with my account, it is just that you blocked it for no reason and I cannot use it.
labelRationale: States satisfaction while describing a grievance-worthy block.

message: The car rental company charged my deposit twice and you approved both. I am unhappy and want the extra deposit back.
labelRationale: Duplicate deposit charge with grievance and refund request.

message: Please add a new payee for my child's school fees so I can pay them next week.
labelRationale: Clear request to add a payee; service request.

message: When I try to upload a document in the app, the progress bar stops at ninety percent.
labelRationale: Neutral report of an upload failure in the app; technical request.

message: Please refund the duplicate payment of 54.90 to the hardware store; it appears twice on my statement for the same day.
labelRationale: Polite refund request for a duplicate charge; a refund of a payment is a synthetic dispute.

message: How long does it usually take to open a second savings account once I apply online?
labelRationale: Neutral question about account opening time; information request.

message: Why does your app never work on weekends? I am losing my patience with constant error messages.
labelRationale: Recurring errors expressed with frustration and a why-question; complaint primary.

message: Increase my card limit to 5000, no wait, lower it to 500, whichever is the default.
labelRationale: Contradictory limit change; human must confirm.

message: Please set up a standing order of 300 to my mother on the first of each month. I will also say I am not impressed with how long your transfers take.
labelRationale: Action request with a mild secondary grievance and no requested outcome; action primary, claim alternative.

message: The app crashes when I open my savings tab. Separately, what is the interest rate on the fixed saver?
labelRationale: Malfunction report plus an unrelated question; incident primary, review to split tasks.

message: What interest rate does the easy access savings account currently pay?
labelRationale: Neutral question about an account product; information request.

message: There seems to be a glitch: my subscription to the streaming service was billed two times this morning. Please give back the extra one.
labelRationale: Duplicate billing framed as a glitch with a refund request; refund makes it a dispute.

message: Which web browsers are supported by your online banking service?
labelRationale: Neutral question about digital channel compatibility; information request.

message: I called support about the app freezing and the agent told me to just use a computer instead. That is useless advice and the app is still broken.
labelRationale: Grievance about support handling a technical issue; support complaint with digital alternative.

message: Your bank put a hold on my current account for a week with no explanation and I could not pay my bills. I want to know who decided this and why.
labelRationale: Grievance about an account restriction asking for investigation; account complaint.

message: The cash machine outside the Market Square branch swallowed my card without dispensing any cash. No money left my account.
labelRationale: Neutral report of an ATM malfunction without loss; technical request.

message: It still does not work.
labelRationale: No subject, domain or outcome; cannot be classified without clarification.

message: Sort it out please, you know what I mean.
labelRationale: Demand for an unspecified action.

message: What is the difference between your two savings accounts? Once you tell me, please move 1000 from my current account into the better one.
labelRationale: Question with a dependent action; primary inquiry but the action requires a decision, so review.

message: Please increase my overdraft limit by 500. Everything else with my account is great.
labelRationale: Positive feedback with a plain service action.

message: Do not refund the duplicate charge, I want to keep things simple, so please just refund it.
labelRationale: Opposite instructions about a refund for a duplicate charge; claim with review.

message: I would like to increase my daily transfer limit for the next two weeks while I buy a car.
labelRationale: Clear request to change a payment limit; service request.

message: What problems can happen if I let my account go overdrawn by accident?
labelRationale: Problem vocabulary in an educational question.

message: What is the daily limit for transfers made through online banking?
labelRationale: Neutral question about payment limits; information request.

message: The app crashes immediately whenever I open the cards section.
labelRationale: Neutral report of an app crash; technical request.

message: My card works everywhere without any problems, except no shop accepts it.
labelRationale: Contradictory card status report.

message: What is your policy on disputing a card charge? Nothing has gone wrong, I am just curious.
labelRationale: Dispute vocabulary in a hypothetical question.

message: Is it normal that nobody replied to my message from last month?
labelRationale: Neutral question or veiled support complaint.

message: No complaints at all, I just need my address changed to 4 Mill Lane.
labelRationale: Explicitly no complaint; address change.

message: Please add my partner to my current account, and also tell me whether you offer travel insurance.
labelRationale: Account action plus a product question; action primary.

message: Three weeks ago I reported that the app shows the wrong balance. Nothing has changed and nobody updates me. I am very unhappy.
labelRationale: Unresolved technical report escalated with grievance; complaint primary.

message: Has something changed with the login? It does not accept my code any more.
labelRationale: Question about a change or a report of a login malfunction.

message: This is the worst app I have ever used. The transfer button does nothing and I missed a payment deadline because of it.
labelRationale: Grievance with consequences caused by an app defect; complaint primary.

message: The website timed out while I was making a transfer and now I do not know if the money went. This is unacceptable for a bank.
labelRationale: Grievance with uncertainty about a payment caused by a timeout; complaint primary.

message: I need you to reverse one of the two identical payments to my insurance company that left my account on Tuesday.
labelRationale: Request to reverse a duplicate payment; refund-type dispute.

message: My salary has not arrived, can you chase it?
labelRationale: Service action or investigation of a missing payment that may become a dispute.

message: The app works brilliantly. Does it also let me see my credit score?
labelRationale: Praise with a neutral feature question.

message: The transfer I made shows completed but my friend has not received it.
labelRationale: Technical issue or payment investigation that may become a dispute.

message: I was charged for a cancelled order and want a refund. The app also crashes on the disputes page, and how long do refunds normally take?
labelRationale: Payment dispute, app defect and a question; dispute primary.

message: I waited on hold for fifty minutes and then the line just went dead. I want an explanation of why your support is this bad.
labelRationale: Grievance about support quality asking for an explanation; support complaint.

message: Who won the football match last night?
labelRationale: Sports question outside the taxonomy.

message: Can you recommend a good plumber in my area?
labelRationale: Local services question outside the taxonomy.

message: I am disappointed that the website still will not let me log in after three days of trying. Fix it.
labelRationale: Dissatisfaction with a login failure; complaint primary, technical alternative.

message: My card stopped working at every terminal today. I also want to mention the branch adviser yesterday was quite rude to my father.
labelRationale: Card malfunction plus a separate staff grievance about a third party; incident primary, claim alternative.

message: Every card payment I made yesterday shows up twice in the app. Is this a display issue or was I really charged twice?
labelRationale: Ambiguous between display defect and real duplicate charge; duplicate charge risk requires review.

message: The hotel booking went through three times on my card and you did nothing to stop it. I want two of those payments back immediately.
labelRationale: Multiple duplicate charges with grievance and refund request.

message: The app says my device is not supported, but it is a phone model released this year.
labelRationale: Neutral report of an incorrect compatibility check; technical request.

message: Could you arrange a cab to take me to the airport at six tomorrow morning?
labelRationale: Paraphrase of a transport booking request outside the taxonomy.

message: Which smartphone has the best camera this year?
labelRationale: Consumer product question unrelated to banking.

message: I need help with my thing from last time.
labelRationale: Refers to unknown prior context; nothing to classify.

message: Please open an additional current account in my name for household bills.
labelRationale: Clear request to open an account; service request.

message: Something is wrong again and I am not happy.
labelRationale: Dissatisfaction without any subject; formal type cannot be determined.

message: Can you order a replacement chequebook for my current account?
labelRationale: Clear request for a service action on an account; service request.

message: Please cancel the direct debit to the old electricity supplier.
labelRationale: Clear request to cancel a payment mandate; service request.

message: My flight was paid for two times, the money has gone from my account twice, and no one told me. Return the second payment today, this is disgraceful.
labelRationale: Paraphrase of a duplicate flight charge complaint.

message: Please write a short poem about autumn for my daughter's school project.
labelRationale: Creative writing request outside the taxonomy.

message: How would I file a complaint if I ever needed to? I just want to know the process.
labelRationale: Mentions complaints but only asks about the process; no grievance.

message: You took a monthly maintenance fee from my account even though I was told the package was free for the first year. I want that fee returned.
labelRationale: Explicit grievance about an unexpected fee with a refund request; payments complaint.

message: I want to add my wife as a joint holder on my savings account.
labelRationale: Clear request to change account holders; service request.

message: Everything in the app works perfectly, except that it crashes every time I open it.
labelRationale: Claims everything works while reporting a total failure; contradictory, needs review.

message: I need to close my old savings account and move the balance into my current account.
labelRationale: Clear request to close an account and move funds; service request.

message: Will I need to register again if I install the app on a new phone?
labelRationale: Neutral question about app registration; information request.

message: Your password reset link says it has expired the moment I click it.
labelRationale: Neutral report of a broken reset flow; technical request.

message: Every time I call I am transferred between four departments and have to repeat my story. Your support process is broken and needs fixing.
labelRationale: Grievance about support process quality asking for a fix; support complaint.

message: Your online banking was down all of payday and I could not pay my staff. I want to know why and I want assurance it will not happen again.
labelRationale: Grievance about an outage with business impact; complaint primary asking to investigate.

message: I am angry that my joint account was converted to a single account without my partner or me agreeing to it. Explain this.
labelRationale: Grievance about an unagreed account change asking for an explanation; account complaint.

message: I would like to change the name on my account after my marriage. What do I need to send?
labelRationale: Request for an account change; the question is subordinate to the action; service request.

message: Can you tell me what documents I need to add a second holder to my current account?
labelRationale: Neutral question about account requirements; information request.

message: The deposit machine at my branch keeps rejecting cheques. Please also send me paying-in slips by post.
labelRationale: Machine malfunction plus a supplies request; incident primary.

message: My charge card statement is due soon. When is the payment taken?
labelRationale: Charge vocabulary in a neutral billing question.

message: The deposit machine in the branch rejected every banknote I tried to pay in today.
labelRationale: Neutral report of a deposit machine malfunction; technical request.

message: Can my partner be put on my current account as a joint holder? And is travel insurance something you offer?
labelRationale: Paraphrase of account action plus a product question.

message: For my savings account, what is the schedule for posting printed statements?
labelRationale: Paraphrase of a neutral statement-frequency question.

message: Scanning a bill with the app camera does nothing, the screen just stays dark.
labelRationale: Neutral report of an app camera defect; technical request.

message: Could you tell me how frequently paper statements are sent for a savings account?
labelRationale: Paraphrase of a neutral statement-frequency question.

message: Is there a maximum amount I can pay to a new payee on the first day?
labelRationale: Neutral question about new payee limits; information request.

message: I am very unhappy that my transfer to my landlord arrived four days late and he charged me a penalty. Please look into why it took so long.
labelRationale: Dissatisfaction about a delayed transfer with a request to investigate; payments complaint.

message: My contactless payments stopped working on my card, although chip and PIN payments still go through.
labelRationale: Neutral report of a card function malfunction; technical request.

message: Your television advert implies that customers who rent are irresponsible. I find it offensive and wanted to say so.
labelRationale: Dissatisfaction with marketing content outside the listed domains; general complaint without outcome.

message: I want to set a nickname for each of my accounts so they are easier to tell apart.
labelRationale: Clear request to change account display settings; service request.

message: What happens to my account if I do not use it for more than a year?
labelRationale: Neutral question about account dormancy rules; information request.
